sections.section_text: 26. Receipt to be given for rent paid - This section mandates that every tenant must pay rent within the time fixed by contract or by the fifteenth day of the following month, and is entitled to receive a written receipt from the landlord or their authorized agent for the amount - paid. If the landlord or agent refuses or neglects to provide a receipt, the Controller may, upon application by the tenant, direct the landlord to pay damages not exceeding double the rent paid, along with the costs of the application.
